prompt_text: A very wide, straight highway under a clear blue sky, with dark roadside barriers, green grass, and long symmetrical rows of tall trees on both sides. The road begins abruptly at a starting point, with no ground behind it—only open sky, as if the road is suspended in space. Bright daytime lighting, clean and minimal environment. First person view.

rubric_items.rubric_text: Does the road remain a very wide, straight highway throughout the video?
Does the sky stay clear blue throughout the video?
Do dark roadside barriers remain visible along the sides of the highway throughout the video?
Do green grass and long symmetrical rows of tall trees remain on both sides of the highway throughout the video?
Does the scene maintain bright daytime lighting and a clean, minimal environment, while showing the road beginning abruptly with open sky behind it instead of ground?
When the roadside barriers are visible and judgeable, do they appear dark in color as specified in the prompt?
When the trees are visible and judgeable, do they appear tall as specified in the prompt?
